# TheStatusQ

> A copywriting and web design studio run by Quinn Crowell. We build lifecycle email programs, conversion-focused websites, and video sales letter scripts for consumer brands and small businesses.

TheStatusQ is a small studio, not an agency network. Quinn Crowell is the founder and does the work. We work remotely with clients in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada.

- Website: https://www.thestatusq.io
- Contact: hello@thestatusq.io
- Founder LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/quinnctsq

## What we do

- **Lifecycle email and Klaviyo.** Welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase and win-back flows built in Klaviyo, plus ongoing campaign copy. Klaviyo setup runs $800 to $1,200. An ongoing email copywriting retainer is $1,500 per month for 3 to 5 emails a week, two-month minimum.
- **Websites and landing pages.** Static and Next.js builds. A single landing page is $1,500. A starter funnel bundling a landing page, Klaviyo setup with UTM tracking and a five-email sequence is $2,800. A full package with a site, copy, a VSL script and a five-email sequence runs $3,500 to $5,000. The script is optional and without it the package is $3,000 to $4,500.
- **VSL scripts.** Video sales letter scripts and short-form ad scripts for a specific offer. A standalone script is $1,000 with two rounds of revisions, delivered in 10 to 14 days. This is the script only, not video production.
- **AI receptionist.** A phone assistant that answers calls, qualifies the caller and books into your calendar. $1,500 to set up and $800 per month. Larger builds adding automated follow-up, CRM and SMS, or a complete funnel are quoted per build.
- **Ongoing maintenance.** A $250 per month retainer covering hosting, security and three content updates a month.

Every price is published at https://www.thestatusq.io/pricing with nothing behind a form.

## How we work

Discovery call, then a written brief, then build, then a review round, then deploy. Most single-page builds take about a week. A multi-page site takes two to four weeks depending on how fast content comes back.

## Accessibility

Builds run an automated accessibility check before they ship and target WCAG 2.1 Level AA. We do not install accessibility overlay widgets, because they do not fix the underlying markup.

## Comparisons

These pages compare the options a buyer is actually weighing up, including the cases where the answer is not to hire us. Prices quoted on them match the pricing page.

- [Klaviyo agency vs freelancer vs in house](https://www.thestatusq.io/klaviyo-agency-vs-freelancer-vs-in-house): what each delivery model costs, including Glassdoor's 2026 average United States email marketing manager salary of $102,544, and the revenue point at which the recommendation changes.
- [Custom website vs Shopify theme vs Wix or Squarespace](https://www.thestatusq.io/custom-website-vs-shopify-theme-vs-website-builder): premium Shopify themes at $180 to $400, builder subscriptions at roughly $29 to $39 a month, and custom builds from $1,500, with the point at which each option runs out.
- [AI receptionist vs answering service vs voicemail](https://www.thestatusq.io/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service-vs-voicemail): flat $800 a month against per minute answering service billing of roughly $0.65 to $1.75, and the call volume at which each becomes correct.
- [Klaviyo flow setup vs email retainer](https://www.thestatusq.io/klaviyo-flow-setup-vs-email-retainer): which of the two to buy first, using Klaviyo's 2026 benchmark finding that flows produce close to 41 percent of email revenue from 5.3 percent of sends.
- [Copywriter vs AI copywriting tools](https://www.thestatusq.io/copywriter-vs-ai-copywriting-tools): what a $39 to $59 a month writing tool does well, where it costs a business money, and how Google's scaled content abuse policy applies.
